name: Jeeter XL Premium Diamonds AIO | Gelato
description:
Gelato - Hybrid

Gelato is a cross between Sunset Sherbet and Thin Mint GSC. Since its birth, a number of phenotypes have been released, all with their own unique attributes. One of them is Gelato, a balanced hybrid with compact buds that stay true to its Cookie genetics. Like other Gelato phenotypes, it’s covered in fiery orange hairs, with buds ranging from dark green to deep purple. It delivers sweet citrus and fruity flavors, making it a go-to for unwinding after a long day.

Jeeter Diamonds XL 2G All-In-One Vapes combine our premium Diamonds extract with next-generation hardware for a smooth, flavorful experience. Built for bigger clouds and consistent performance, the Diamonds XL is packed with innovative features that elevate every session.

• 2G XL capacity with premium Diamonds extract

• Dual ceramic core technology for bigger clouds & smoother heating

• Digital display with cloud count, battery life & heat modes

• Optimized airflow and postless design for consistent performance

• Pre-heat function and reverse inhale support to help reduce clogs
